topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Well, they say the miller's hand often changes, and so it goes with the squire’s men too. heard that old Tom’s been shifted over to tend the sheep instead of the forge. Mind you, it’s no surprise. They say the new man from the next vale is a sight more steady with the bellows. Tom’ll do well enough with the flock; he’s always had a way with the beasts. I reckon it’s for the best. The sheep could use a kind hand, and the smithy’ll be better off with someone who knows the fire and iron. Change comes slow here, but when it does, we try to make it fit.
